Name: Ancient Grapes
Author: Oexi
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is required! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url] also recommended.[color=#f4f4f4][b]
[/b][/color]
Configuration options:
- Buy From: Krobus and/or Pierre (default Krobus)
- Buy Price (default 500)
- Unlimited Stock (default false, limited to 3)
- Days to Grow (default 14)
- Days to Regrow (default 7)
- Base Sell Price (default 750)
- Needs Watering (default true)
- Grows in Winter (default false, grows in spring, summer, and fall) 

Ancient Grapes are a new trellis crop that grows in all seasons except winter. This is meant to provide an alternative to mid to late game wine crops such as Ancient Fruit and Starfruit, while allowing for the visuals and vibe of a vineyard. Growth times and prices can be adjusted in config.json or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. Watering can also be turned off, which I find especially useful since sprinklers can be very frustrating to plan vineyard layouts around. With lowered sell price and growth times, they can also function as a slightly more profitable year-round Grape alternative. 

As of 1.6 and the release of the Content Patcher version, this no longer requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] and its dependencies. [color=#f4f4f4]If updating this mod from the JA version, delete [JA] Ancient Grapes.[/color]

Presumably incompatible with other mods adding items with the same name such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8684]Grapes of Ferngill[/url].
